div.head: Northu 43
div.ab: Gif preost geargerihta unmynegode læte, gebete þæt.
Gif preost geargerihta unmynegode læte, gebete þæt.
Wenn ein Priester die jährlichen Gerechtsame [der Kirche] uneingefordert lässt, büsse er das.
If a priest leaves the annual dues [of the church] unclaimed, let him atone for it.
If a priest leaves the yearly dues undemanded, he is to compensate for it.
If a priest permits the yearly dues to go uncollected, he is to atone for that.

note.seg: Nicht gearesgive, die (auch Nordische) Neujahrsgabe an die Kirche (Steenstrup III 387); s. o. 38 gear und bei Toller die Composita gearcyning (dom), geartorht, ferner gearmarket Urk. Ke 956, worin auch gear- jährlich bedeutet

Not gearesgive, the New Year’s gift to the church (found in the North too) (Steenstrup III 387); see above 38 gear, and in Toller the compounds gearcyning (dom), geartorht, also gearmarket charter Ke 956, in which gear- likewise means ‘annual’
